reason: Provides DeepSeek Harness skills for selecting and resuming Codex or Claude Code sessions by reading external session records, summarizing handoff context, and verifying current repository state without launching or delegating to those agents.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供读取 Codex 和 Claude Code 历史会话、生成交接摘要并在当前会话中继续工作的技能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness skills to read Codex and Claude Code session history, generate handoff summaries, and continue work in the current session.

capabilities: Reads local Codex and Claude Code session records
Processes historical session data into handoff summaries
Reads current repository state before continuing work
